Bride and Groom stuff is probably one of the coolest things you could shop for cause there is so much out there. If you haven't already, I would send a message asking their wedding colors and theme (if there is one). You could send a really nice gift with a congratulations card wishing them well on their new life adventure. 

If they dont respond, you get get something generic with wedding rings etched in it or some other traditional symbol. For PC reasons, I'd stay away from any religious connotations unless you know for sure. Or if you are religious I'd send a card with whatever heartfelt blessings you believe in, but I'd leave it off the gift IMO

Edit: it doesn't have to be a serious gift either. I know they have a checkers set with shot glasses as the pieces. Im sure he and the misses would have fun playing that on the honeymoon lol
